CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION search_suppliers(p_query text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 15)
RETURNS TABLE (
    id uuid,
    full_name text,
    trade_name text,
    document_number text,
    active boolean,
    type text
) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_digits text;
    v_normalized text;
BEGIN
    -- Isola dígitos para busca de CNPJ
    v_digits := regexp_replace(p_query, '\D', '', 'g');
    
    -- Escapa % e _ no texto livre para uso com ILIKE
    v_normalized := replace(replace(p_query, '%', '\%'), '_', '\_');

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT p.id, p.full_name, p.trade_name, p.document_number, p.active, p.type
    FROM people p
    WHERE p.type = 'suppliers'
    AND p.deleted = false
    AND (
        (v_digits <> '' AND regexp_replace(p.document_number, '\D', '', 'g') LIKE '%' || v_digits || '%')
        OR p.full_name ILIKE '%' || v_normalized || '%'
        OR p.trade_name ILIKE '%' || v_normalized || '%'
    )
    ORDER BY
        -- Ordenação por relevância:
        -- 1. Documento Exato
        -- 2. Nome/Razão Exata
        -- 3. Fantasia Exata
        -- 4. Começa com Nome/Razão
        -- 5. Começa com Fantasia
        -- 6. Outros matches (contém)
        CASE 
            WHEN v_digits <> '' AND regexp_replace(p.document_number, '\D', '', 'g') = v_digits THEN 1
            WHEN p.full_name ILIKE v_normalized THEN 2
            WHEN p.trade_name ILIKE v_normalized THEN 3
            WHEN p.full_name ILIKE v_normalized || '%' THEN 4
            WHEN p.trade_name ILIKE v_normalized || '%' THEN 5
            ELSE 6
        END,
        p.full_name
    LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$$;
